1.

By our dated 5th September, 2023 we had directed Respondent No.4 to submit a proposal to Shyamlal Hariram Chandnani vs Principal Secretary Urban Development ... on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138859907/
1 CIDCO regarding the compensation payable for acquisition of the Petitioners land.

entities.text: Shyamlal Hariram Chandnani vs Principal Secretary Urban Development
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We had also directed that once this proposal is received by CIDCO, they shall deposit the said amount with the concerned authority within a period of OCTOBER 17, 2023 Utkarsh 28.wp.7652.2023.doc 4 weeks thereafter.
Once the amount was deposited with Respondent No.4, it was directed to deposit the said amount with the concerned Reference Court within a period of 1 week of receipt of the amount from CIDCO.
With these directions we had disposed of the Writ Petition but kept the matter on board for compliance today.

2. Today when the above matter is called out, we are informed that the directions given in the order dated 5 th September, 2023 have been duly complied with and compensation for the Petitioners land has been deposited by CIDCO with Respondent No.4.

Since this has been done, we find that no further orders are necessary except to direct Respondent No.4 to deposit the amount received from CIDCO in relation to the Petitioners land with the concerned Reference Court within a period of 2 weeks from today, instead of 1 week as stipulated in the order dated 5th September, 2023.
3. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ M.M.
SATHAYE, J.] [ B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.]
